notes: US 708 is explicitly equated with HVS 2 in T:p2-b0. It was previously identified as an unbound hypervelocity star (T:p18-b2; reference 2 title at T:p10-b3), and this paper reanalyzes it while retaining its unbound status (T:p4-b2); it is therefore recorded as a follow-up study of a previously identified candidate.

US 708: Coordinates are J2000 from T:p18-b2. The Palomar 866–936 km s^-1 entry in T:p18-b4 is reported as a range of measured radial velocities. The abstract (T:p2-b0) and Supplementary Text (T:p27-b2) quote ∼1200 km s^-1 as a rounded description of the 1157 ± 53 km s^-1 Galactic rest-frame velocity. No numerical parallax, galactocentric radius, or bound/unbound probability is reported.
